text:
Marta L: quick UX review  users assume KMS chips mean keys move with a workspace. current modal text: 'Encryption keys may be affected'  too vague.
Devon H: agree. split retention and KMS into clear sections in the modal. header: 'Change project region' short line: 'Moving a project can change where data is stored and which keys are usable.'
Priya M: copy proposal (short): 'Customer-managed keys are region-bound and do not transfer. You can add a new key in the destination region or use platform-managed encryption.' add a small 'Learn more' link to docs.
Anand R: accessibility: tooltip & modal must be keyboard focusable; use aria-describedby for tooltips and role=dialog + aria-modal=true. if we add confirm checkbox for destructive moves, Esc must not dismiss.
Marta L: CTA options debate: primary 'Move project' (non-blocking) vs primary 'Move and add key' (blocking). Engineering favors non-blocking + post-move persistent banner.
Devon H: banner draft: 'Customer key unavailable in <region>. Add key' CTA 'Add key' secondary 'Remind me later'. use icon + text; do not rely on color alone. hex for review: border #D97706, icon #92400E, bg pale #FFF7ED (note: pale bg fails AA at 14px). include darker border or darker bg in ticket.
Priya M: audit log samples: UI: 'Marta L moved project orion from us-west1 to eu-central1; retention defaulted to 30 days; customer KMS unavailable.' machine: 'event=region_move actor=Marta_L from=us-west1 to=eu-central1 retention=defaulted_30d kms=unavailable tag=region-change'
Anand R: dev acceptance criteria: include short+expanded copy, ARIA attributes for tooltip/modal/banner, contrast swatches with AA results, audit-log sample strings, mobile truncation rules for KMS chip, and mock for modal+post-move banner flow.
Preview Bot: preview of updated modal + banner deployed to staging at 1898765480: https://staging.redwood.cloud/preview/1898765480
Marta L: thanks all  I'll file the ticket with annotated mocks and tag @Anand R for implementation estimate and @Priya M for copy sign-off. :white_check_mark:
